documents.text: Item 3.01 Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule. On February 10, 2025, the Company received a notification letter from Nasdaq indicating that the Company is not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement. The Nasdaq deficiency notice provides a 180-day period to regain compliance.

Item 3.03 Material Modification to Rights of Security Holders. On April 1, 2025, the Company effected a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its common stock. The reverse stock split was approved by stockholders on March 15, 2025. Outstanding shares were reduced from 100,000,000 to 5,000,000.

Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2025. The Company reported a net loss of $400,000. Management believes existing cash is adequate for operations. No going concern language is included in this filing.
